End of 1Q: Lakers 31, Hawks 22

Solid first quarter from the Lakers, with Luka Doncic leading all scorers with nine points.

Sandro Mamukelashvili and Jarred Vanderbilt finished the quarter with a game-high plus-17. Early season Vando minutes once again making an impact.

The Hawks scored 3 points in the final 5:47 of the first quarter.

20-3 run for the Lakers over that span to turn an 8-point lead into a 9-point deficit.

The bench unit got summarily torched.

Quiet part about the Lakers second unit trending smaller is they just automatically hit the switching button. Not new for the Lakers defense, try to contain drives, show early help. Turn defense into offense.
